The offer is valid from 1 September to 31 October 2026. For each person you successfully refer who signs up with Ultimate Performance during the offer period, you will receive two complimentary personal training sessions. The referred client must complete their sign-up to a full package before the complimentary sessions can be credited. Complimentary sessions are awarded to the referring client and are non-transferable. There is no limit to the number of successful referrals you can make during the offer period, subject to the terms of the offer. The offer is available across Ultimate Performance gyms in the UK, US, Amsterdam, Singapore, Dubai and Sydney. Additional Emerald Health benefits (London) London-based Ultimate Performance clients can also access the following exclusive Emerald Health benefits as part of the 2+2 referral offer: For your first successful referral during the offer period, you will receive one year of complimentary Emerald Health membership.The complimentary Emerald Health membership is limited to one per referring client and cannot be claimed again for subsequent referrals during the offer period. The complimentary Emerald Health membership must be claimed within two months of the referred client's sign-up date. If it is not claimed within this period, the offer will expire. Each new client referred through the 2+2 offer will receive 30% off an Emerald Health membership. The referred client's 30% discount applies to their own Emerald Health membership and is not dependent on the referring client making any further successful referrals. Emerald Health benefits are available to eligible London clients only and are subject to Emerald Health membership terms and conditions. Expert insights. Real results.
